verdict.rationale: Letta's agents can analyze the user's own data inside the product: they explore connected GitHub repositories, sweep bug reports, and work with files on connected machines. /init inspects a repository to build memory, /doctor audits memory for drift and duplication, and dreaming reviews past conversations to consolidate lessons. This is general agent work on request rather than a dedicated feature that proactively surfaces insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: a purpose-built insights or suggestions feature, proactive recommendations drawn from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
